import pytest

def test_daterange_year_step_with_december_start():
    import pytest
    from datetime import date
    from boltons.timeutils import daterange

    start_day = date(2012, 12, 25)
    end_day = date(2023, 1, 1)
    step = (1, 0, 0)
    expected = [
        date(2012, 12, 25),
        date(2013, 12, 25),
        date(2014, 12, 25),
        date(2015, 12, 25),
        date(2016, 12, 25),
        date(2017, 12, 25),
        date(2018, 12, 25),
        date(2019, 12, 25),
        date(2020, 12, 25),
        date(2021, 12, 25),
        date(2022, 12, 25),
    ]
    result = list(daterange(start_day, end_day, step=step, inclusive=False))
    assert result == expected
